label: Target-free cross-family conjecture pilot (#1834): prima via and act/potency against the quarta via
summary:
Target-free conjecture pilot (#1834) at cf7a567a5, families: actualization (prima via first mover 7bce7007/c27dce66/74eb9113/a594d8c4 and act/potency at a first being ca55ed3a/61ad11f3/8288ff1e/0cf675c4, rival c1acdf6c) and grades (quarta via maximum eaa4c679/0881e859/957a71fe/5a594b1e, stage-2 link 4c79298d, rival 2f9fb010); registered bridge 46326b43 not counted as a family. Fifteen candidates from four templates (T1 transport along 46326b43, T2 first-being properties at the maximum via eaa4c679, T3 on to GOD_4 via 4c79298d, T4 rival incompatibility), fixed before search in explorations/conjectures/actualization-grades-1834.toml and certified by scripts/discover_conjecture.py (Duper after delta-unfolding, single deletions, vacuity, prove-sweep transcription probe, literal negation, models checked by decide or simp, every check within the three allowed axioms). Identification rule: same parameter name in one module, or one whole-binder sense tag (by sense id), or a carrier forced by such a relation identification. Verified conditional implications, each with a certified joint witness including an antecedent instance: C07 eaa4c679+ca55ed3a give 'every maximum in being cannot fail to be' (omission models for both premises); C09 eaa4c679+61ad11f3 give act priority (POTENCY_2) at the maximum (omission model only for 61ad11f3; eaa4c679 is kept only because its deletion failed within the budget, not shown needed); C10 4c79298d+eaa4c679+ca55ed3a give 'whatever is GOD_4 is CORRUPTIBLE_INCORRUPTIBLE_1' (omission models for all three), persisted as 5d6beff2 (result 75ec568c, axiom-free controls 32c078f4). Each joins the two families only through PRIOR_1, tagged on both declarations; the Theta.8 respect carrier is kept apart. Certified non-implications: C01 (46326b43+eaa4c679 do not give 74eb9113 without a maximum: the identity bridge is vacuous without the witness); C05b (God GOD_2 and IsGod GOD_4 apart: no derivation of a594d8c4; 'every GOD_2 is GOD_4' is one sufficient OPEN bridge, not shown to be weakest, valid only together with the MovedIn/MovesIn and carrier identifications of C02-C04); C11 (the three premises and C10's conclusion do not give the tertia via's necessary being of DEF-NECESSARY-BEING, x cannot not-be; one sufficient OPEN bridge, not shown weakest: 'whatever cannot fail to be in being cannot not-be'; with the registered converse b8d21cd0 it would make the two senses coextensive); C14 (the potency-first rival c1acdf6c is jointly satisfiable with 61ad11f3, eaa4c679 and 0881e859 in a three-being model; mutual simple priority is admissible there because no asymmetry premise is in the bundle). C05b and C11 are immediate non-implications, since their conclusions use binders fresh to the premises: they name a missing link, not substantive independence. OPEN by identification (proved in Lean only under binder identifications that no module convention or whole-binder sense tag licenses; not theorems about the statements): C02 (46326b43+eaa4c679+0881e859 give 74eb9113; 'minimal' only by failed single deletions), C03 (46326b43+7bce7007 give 5a594b1e), C04 (46326b43+0881e859 give c27dce66), C05 (the word 'God' identifying GOD_2 with GOD_4: name-only control), C08 (eaa4c679+0cf675c4), C12 (2f9fb010+0881e859+46326b43+7bce7007 inconsistent: would refute the rival from the prima via), C13 (single-family version with 5a594b1e). Exact obligations: MovedIn and MovesIn of StageOne (7bce7007, c27dce66, a594d8c4), StageOneBridges (74eb9113) and StageOneQuartaVia (46326b43) carry no whole-binder sense tag; PriorSimply of 74eb9113 and 0cf675c4 is untagged (PRIOR_1 on eaa4c679); the binders of 2f9fb010 are untagged. Rejected: C06 (tautology). Inconsistent bundles (C12, C13) are incompatibilities under the named identifications, never support. Baseline at the same revision: truth discover on 74eb9113, 5a594b1e, c27dce66 and a594d8c4 (premise pool all, 10 candidates) found 0 discoveries: three unresolved (retrieval did not bring 46326b43 with eaa4c679 or 957a71fe into the goals), one proof of 5a594b1e filtered domain_by_name, one missing bridge 'PureAct x gives MovedIn x r' that would make c27dce66 hold vacuously. truth bridge-experiments over the 18 results concluding these targets under three profile modules surfaced only the #320 thisness question, within one family. Limits and connection plan: C10 is a short composition; its interest is the explicit GOD_4 to CORRUPTIBLE_INCORRUPTIBLE_1 link and the visible dependence on ca55ed3a (no direct warrant on file; a horizontal derivation from the tertia via is specified in docs/notes/esse-cause-efficiency-1633.md; rival: a contingent first being). Duper proofs are classical; the persisted proofs use no axiom. frontier-diff: no change. 5d6beff2 reaches no root route. The named consumer 32a2f51c (necessary-root node, tertia via reading) is itself disconnected: it is concluded only by results listed in truth orphans and appears in frontier --reaching-root only as a strengthening target. Missing steps to it: C11's bridge; instantiating Possible, IsAt and Time as FramePossible m.ontic w, ExistsIndexed m.ontic and W; identifying GodIsIncorruptibleSimply.IsGod with Signature.IsGod (the new GOD_4 tag covers the declaration binder, not that instantiation); and the root facts of 32a2f51c from another route. No root-route consumer of GOD_4 incorruptibility exists: the stage-2 Immutable and Eternal attribute nodes (arguments 38244f91, e4d20a58) take POTENCY_1 immutability, not CORRUPTIBLE_INCORRUPTIBLE_1, and no bridge between them is registered. Label note: DEF-NECESSARY-BEING d77ab971 is labelled NECESSARY_1 but is the sense NECESSARY_3 of DISAMB-NECESSARY (and NECESSITY_OF_ONE_INDIVIDUAL_VERSUS_NECESSARY_3, NECESSARY_BEING_1 elsewhere); this inconsistency predates #1834 and is not repaired here. The witness 'instance' fields (antecedent instances for C02, C07, C09, C10) were added after the first run whose candidates were fixed in advance; they add checks and change no candidate. Next tests: (1) review whole-binder sense tags for MovedIn/MovesIn across the stage-1 prima via declarations and PRIOR_1 for 74eb9113's PriorSimply, then rerun C02-C04 and C12; (2) assess C11's bridge and the instantiation steps above toward 32a2f51c; (3) tag 2f9fb010's binders to test whether C12 refutes that rival; (4) sequential deletion to minimize C09 and C02. Curation (#2103, 2026-11-27, PR #2156): the classical converse tertia via to box K, previously noted but unregistered, is now result dedd529a (tertiaViaToBoxK, with excluded middle 
ee4ab504), with the Comparator companion tertiaViaIffBoxK proving the two nodes equivalent under excluded middle. The tertia via node 32a2f51c and, through 54feb72b, the per se node c639d164 reach the root through this equivalence only; no warrant is added to cdf897a8.
